title: INTERVAL — shared definitions
description: Only invariant tokens are centralised here; codes whose label differs by variable are inlined per field.

dont_know_prefer_not_to_answer.title: Don't know / prefer not to answer
dont_know_prefer_not_to_answer.$comment: Source: '999 = don't know / prefer not to answer' (some items state only '999 = don't know' — those inline their own label).

not_applicable.title: Not applicable
not_applicable.$comment: Source: '998 = not applicable'. The dictionary does not state which answers make an item not applicable (D014).

no_value_recorded.title: No value recorded
no_value_recorded.description: The provider's data carries a blank where no value was recorded and the dictionary defines no code for it; the blank is a JSON null (D021).
no_value_recorded.$comment: Not a code from the dictionary: the dictionary defines no code for a missing value. D021.
